items.raw_excerpt: The community of Ngqeleni in the Eastern Cape is working together to refurbish three classrooms
items.summary_en: A community in Ngqeleni, Eastern Cape, is working together to repair three classrooms that were damaged by fire. Volunteers and local groups have joined forces to restore the school buildings so children can return to class.

items.raw_excerpt: I've been thinking about abundance lately. Not the version we see in the media, where the goal is always bigger and more and the next thing. I mean the simpler sort. The sense that there's enough, that you are enough, and that life is asking less of you than you think.
items.summary_en: A writer reflects on the simple abundance of life. They remind readers that August is a good time to slow down and reconnect with themselves. The message is about finding peace in what you already have.
items.summary_ko: 작가는 단순한 풍요로움에 대해 이야기합니다. 8월은 자신에게 집중하고 다시 연결하기 좋은 시간이라는 메시지를 전합니다. 이미 가진 것에서 평화를 찾는 것이 핵심입니다.
items.title_en: A month for coming back to yourself

items.raw_excerpt: Keralam launches a digital mechanism for Onam markets, ensuring fair pricing for farmers and stable fruit and vegetable costs.
items.summary_en: Kerala has introduced a digital grading and pricing mechanism for its special Onam markets. The system aims to ensure fair prices for farmers while keeping fruit and vegetable costs stable for shoppers. This is part of efforts to modernize the traditional festival markets in the state.

items.raw_excerpt: The department undertook urgent electrical infrastructure repairs at Steve Biko Hospital on Saturday
items.summary_en: Gauteng province's health budget is under growing pressure as the population increases. The department carried out urgent electrical repairs at Steve Biko Hospital on Saturday. Rising demand is straining public health resources across the province.

items.raw_excerpt: A new dissolvable 3D-printed patch has been developed by researchers in Belfast with the aim of improving treatment for localised skin cancer.
items.summary_en: Researchers in Belfast created a new dissolvable 3D-printed patch for skin cancer treatment. The patch is designed to improve care for localized skin cancer.

items.raw_excerpt: There is a peculiar phenomenon among British expats here in Portugal.
items.summary_en: British expats living in Portugal reflect on their life back in Britain. Many say the sunny weather and relaxed pace of life have changed how they see their old home. The story highlights the small, everyday feelings of people living far from where they grew up.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈에 살고 있는 영국 출신 이주자들이 고향 영국에서의 삶을 돌아보고 있다. 많은 이들이 화창한 날씨와 여유로운 생활 속에서 고향이 어떻게 달라 보이는지 이야기한다. 이 글은 고향을 떠나 먼 곳에서 살아가는 사람들의 소소한 일상을 전한다.

items.raw_excerpt: A demonstration has taken place in Dublin city centre calling on the HSE to approve reimbursement for Skyclarys, a drug used to treat Friedreich's Ataxia.
items.summary_en: Demonstrators gathered in Dublin city centre calling on the HSE to approve reimbursement for Skyclarys, a treatment for Friedreich's Ataxia. The rare genetic disease affects approximately 1 in 50,000 people. Campaigners say the drug offers hope for patients with the progressive condition.
items.summary_ko: 시위자들이 더블린 시내에서 희귀 유전 질환인 프리드리히 운동실조증 치료제 스카이클라리스의 건강보험 적용을 승인해 달라고 보건청에 촉구했다. 이 질환은 약 5만 명 중 1명에게 발생한다. 시위자들은 이 약물이 진행성 질환 환자들에게 희망을 줄 수 있다고 밝혔다.
items.title_en: Dublin campaigners push for rare disease drug approval

items.raw_excerpt: The prime minister called on employers to make sure becoming a parent never disadvantages someone’s career.

items.summary_en: A nonprofit and a local public health agency are helping Austin musicians pay for health insurance. Rising healthcare costs have made the program more expensive, but the organizations continue their support. The effort aims to keep uninsured musicians covered.

items.raw_excerpt: Laxman Savadi criticizes BJP for disrupting Assembly with irrelevant issues, urging focus on pressing matters like drought relief.
items.summary_en: Former Karnataka minister Laxman Savadi has criticized the BJP for disrupting Assembly sessions with unnecessary issues. He urged the party to focus on urgent matters such as drought relief instead. The remarks highlight growing tensions over the state government's priorities.

items.raw_excerpt: Orioli – One of Europe’s best coffee shops
items.summary_en: Orioli Coffee & Lab in Lisbon was ranked 26th among Europe's 100 Best Coffee Shops in 2026. Founded by Brazilian coffee professional Felipe Orioli, the café roasts and blends beans on site, some from his own farm in Brazil. Visitors can enjoy specialty coffee in a relaxed space with cozy seating areas.

items.raw_excerpt: A história de retomada dos territórios pelos povos indígenas Katxuyana e Kahyana estará em exposição a partir do dia 25 deste mês no Parque Zoobotânico do Museu Paraense Emílio Goeldi, em Belém. A mostra Katxar kum neero | Nossos lugares verdadeiros reúne fotografias, relatos e artefatos produzidos pelos povos desde 1960. São memórias e patrimônios dispersados pelo tempo quando parte dos indígenas foram separados e isolados após serem impedidos de permanecer em seu território tradicional. Txamat
items.summary_en: An exhibition at the Paraense Emílio Goeldi Museum in Belém shares how the Katxuyana and Kahyana indigenous peoples reclaimed their territories. The show features photographs, stories, and artifacts documenting their journey since 1960.
items.summary_ko: 벨렘에 위치한 파라엔스 에밀리오 골디 박물관에서 카투야나와 카하야나 원주민이 영토를 탈환한 이야기를 전시합니다. 1960년부터의 여정을 담은 사진, 이야기, 유물이 전시됩니다.
items.title_en: Katxuyana and Kahyana Peoples Tell Story of Territory Reclamation Through Art
